column1: # Provenance of every real photo and video this product ships. One row per published file.
# Checked by `ds imagery`; how to fill it: the real-imagery guide in the design kit.
# asset     the published file, from the repo root
# original  the original filename or the library uuid (osxphotos uuid, or the NAS path)
# captured  capture date, YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with HH:MM:SS
# camera    EXIF make and model, e.g. Apple iPhone 15 Pro
# source    photos (the owner's photo library) or nas
# consent   owner-ok YYYY-MM-DD for identifiable people, one OK per photo; n/a otherwise
# note      optional: crop, edit, who is shown and why the OK covers it
# Columns are separated by tabs. Lines starting with # are comments. Example row:
